opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grant

deadlines.raw: 1st October 2026 (bi-monthly: 1st Feb, Apr, Jun, Aug, Oct, Dec)

amount.raw: Scheme A up to £200; Scheme B up to £500 (Adelphi co-sponsored up to £750); Scheme C up to £300

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society 'junior scientist' members: Scheme A open to undergraduate, Master's and PhD students and postdocs within 6 years of PhD viva; Schemes B & C open to PhD students and postdocs within 6 years of PhD viva. Applicants must present a poster or give a talk at the conference.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at conferences on genetics research. Three streams: (A) GS/SIG meetings, (B) non-GS meetings, (C) virtual conferences.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or attending a course held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Grants to enable members to attend formal short training courses, or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Awards to cover travel and accommodation costs associated with a field-based genetic research project, funded by income from the Society's journal Heredity. Research should produce results suitable for publication in Heredity.

opportunities.title: Summer Studentship

amount.raw: £425/week allowance for up to 8 weeks; up to £750 host laboratory expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate students (except those in their first or final year); project must be based at a UK university; both student and group leader must be Genetics Society members.
opportunities.summary: Grants to support undergraduate students to gain experience in any area of genetics by doing a research project during the summer holiday prior to the final year of their degree, including a place at the Summer School Workshop.

opportunities.title: Research Access Placements

amount.raw: £425/week for up to 8 weeks; £160 flexible allowance; up to £750 research costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any undergraduate student from an underrepresented and/or minoritised background in the biosciences (e.g. member of a minoritised group, in receipt of full student loan, declared disability, refugee status, or caring responsibilities).
opportunities.summary: A partnership with BBSRC supporting fully paid summer research internships for undergraduate students from underrepresented and/or minoritised backgrounds in the biosciences, including workshops and mentorship.

opportunities.title: Communicating Your Science Workshop

amount.raw: Each place represents an investment of around £2,000 by the society; travel, accommodation and meals covered

opportunities.eligibility_summary: PhD student and postdoctoral researcher Genetics Society members working in genetics and related areas; application must be accompanied by a supporting letter from the supervisor.
opportunities.summary: A workshop bringing together experts to help members develop science communication skills, including storytelling, public talks, demonstrations and multimedia.

opportunities.title: Carer's Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any Genetics Society member with caring responsibilities, regardless of age of the person they care for; priority given to early-career scientists and according to need.
opportunities.summary: Awards to support members with caring responsibilities to attend Society meetings, used as the awardee thinks best supports their attendance.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: Specific lecture a few hundred pounds; session up to about £1,000; major sponsorship £1,000-£2,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members; meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of genetic-themed meetings not organised directly by the Genetics Society, towards the organisation of a meeting (not attendance).

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Grants to support public engagement activities related to genetics, delivered in person or virtually, covering eligible travel and materials costs.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group (SIG) Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members; meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of research meetings on particular themes for genetics research communities wishing to run regular series of meetings.
